name: wiseppc
description: Amazon Ads and seller analytics for WisePPC. Connects Cursor to the WisePPC MCP server for campaign, search-term and product performance, seller reports (sales and traffic, economics, inventory, fees, brand analytics), Brand Store, A+ content, Amazon Attribution links and catalog health, guided runbooks, and whole listing and catalog records over the WisePPC REST API, then submits ad and seller listing changes that a person approves in the WisePPC webapp or that are sent directly, as your API key's grants decide.

WISEPPC_API_KEY.title: WisePPC API key
WISEPPC_API_KEY.description: WisePPC API key (wpp_ak_…). Used as a Bearer token for https://mcp.wiseppc.com/mcp. Never commit this value.
